en:
Hey, Tenko. I've been wanting to ask you
something...

You seem to really adore Himiko.
Why is that?
Eeehh!? U-Um, well...

Oh, was that rude of me to ask?
If you don't wanna tell me, that's fine.

N-No! It's not a secret or anything...
It's just...

<CLT=cltMIND>Wow, Tenko's normally so energetic, but
now she's being all fidgety!

Um...I would prefer that you not share this
with Himiko...
Yeah, of course I won't tell her!
W-Well then... Um, I...I admire...
Her magic tricks!?

Wha—!? No! Himiko doesn't do magic tricks,
she casts spells like a mage!

O-Oh, yeah! Hm, I see...so you wanna
be a mage like Himiko!
No, that's not it! That's not it at all!

It's just...I really like...and really admire...
performers.

Okay...and what does that have to do with
Himiko?

Because my dream is to be a cute magical
girl like Himiko and perform for people!
That's the reason... Hehehehehe...
Uh-huh, I see...

B-But I can't cast spells like Himiko, and
I'm not cute like her either...

Huh? Seriously? I know I've said this before,
but I think you're cute, Tenko.

N-N-N-No I'm not! When I sneeze, my face
gets all scrunched and wrinkled!
Your smile is charming
Your passion is your secret weapon
You have a great body
Are you unsure of something?

Everyone's face does that.
But in your case, I think...
Your smile is charming.

My smile is crude and vulgar! And when I
laugh, my mouth takes up my whole face!
You're not crude or vulgar!

You smile like you're having loads of fun,
and that makes me smile, too.
You...think so?
Your passion is your secret weapon.

My weapon is <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
And it's no secret!

That's not what I mean... I meant, your
passionate energy is the weapon.

My passionate energy, huh? I *have* been
told that it gives people headaches!

I thought I was being mocked! But it turns
out, I was being praised the whole time!

<CLT=cltMIND>U-Um...I think we should stop this
conversation now.
You have a great body.

What are you talking about!? I've got stubby
limbs and a long torso like a weiner dog!

...Someone who hears that might think you're
being sarcastic, and get offended...

What!? I don't mean to offend anyone!
Geez, words are scary sometimes...
Anyway, I think you're a really charming girl...

Maybe you could do your own thing as an
Aikido performer? I'm sure you could do it!

Oooohhh!!! An Aikido performer!
I never even considered that!

That sounds awesome! I could use my talent
to help <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> get more exposure!

That's right! And who knows, you might end
up becoming really popular and strike it rich!

You've given me a whole new perspective!
I'm so touched! Thank you, Kaede!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko performing her Neo-Aikido in front
of an audience...

<CLT=cltMIND>Once we escape, she can take hold of that
dream...and we can all take hold of ours!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tenko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Tenko, I returned
to my room.
